title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World, Mar 6, 2027
description: This Springfield Symphony Orchestra concert, From the New World, features Dvořák's New World Symphony, Adolphus Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra, and Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto with violinist Fiona Shea, the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. The program draws on Dvořák's call for American composers to take inspiration from African American music. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
